key.name: log-direct-scanout
key.summary: Log when displays show fullscreen windows directly
key.description: When on, the compositor writes to the journal whenever a display starts or stops showing a fullscreen window's buffer directly, and when the desktop takes long to appear again afterwards.

key.name: log-variable-refresh
key.summary: Log when displays switch between variable and fixed refresh
key.description: When on, the compositor writes to the journal whenever the window covering a display changes, saying whether the display's refresh rate follows that window or stays fixed, and why.
